title: AppsFlyer pricing | A plan for every marketing budget

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's Zero plan is listed with a Free price tag and is aimed at apps seeking a simple tool for owned media activities.
facts.quote: Ideal for apps seeking a simple tool for owned media activities*

facts.fact: The Zero plan is marked as not suitable for apps with paid activities.
facts.quote: Not suitable for apps with paid activities

facts.fact: The Zero plan includes a Welcome Package with 12K free conversions for the first year.
facts.quote: Zero plan includes a Welcome Package with 12K free conversions for the first year, core marketing analytics, and 30 days of access to select premium add-ons.

facts.fact: The Growth plan is listed as Pay-as-you-go pricing and is described as best for startups requiring basic measurement as they start paid campaigns.
facts.quote: Best for startups requiring basic measurement as they start their paid campaigns

facts.fact: The Growth plan includes a Welcome Package with 12K free conversions for the first year.
facts.quote: Growth plan includes a Welcome Package with 12K free conversions for the first year, core marketing analytics, and 30 days of access to select premium add-ons.

facts.fact: After the Welcome Package, AppsFlyer's Growth plan prices conversions at $0.07 each.
facts.quote: Following the Welcome Package, conversions are priced at $0.07 each.

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's Enterprise plan uses custom pricing.
facts.quote: Custom pricing

facts.fact: AppsFlyer states its Deep Linking and audience segmentation features include dynamic sync with 90+ API partners.
facts.quote: Dynamic sync with 90+ API partners

facts.fact: The AppsFlyer Welcome Package includes 12,000 free conversions to be used within the first 12 months of signing up.
facts.quote: 12,000 free conversions to be used within the first 12 months of signing up.

facts.fact: The AppsFlyer Welcome Package includes a 30-day trial of select premium add-ons, including Raw Data API Access, API Analytics Suite, and Custom Dashboards.
facts.quote: A 30-day trial of select premium add-ons, including:

facts.fact: The 30-day trial period for AppsFlyer premium add-ons begins immediately upon completing the sign-up process.
facts.quote: The 30-day trial period for the premium add-ons begins immediately upon completing the sign-up process.

facts.fact: Both the Zero and Growth AppsFlyer plans get a one-time bonus of the first 12,000 conversion measurements free.
facts.quote: Both the Zero and Growth plans get a special one-time bonus: your first 12,000 conversion measurements are free

facts.fact: Organic installs or actions that AppsFlyer does not attribute are not counted as conversions and are free.
facts.quote: “Organic” installs or actions, those that AppsFlyer does not attribute, are not counted as conversions and are totally free.

facts.fact: AppsFlyer accepts all major credit cards, PayPal and, in select countries, direct debit as payment options.
facts.quote: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal and (in select countries) direct debit.

facts.fact: The annual mobile advertising budget answer options on the AppsFlyer demo form range from $0 to $2.5M+, with bands including $1-$50K, $51K–$200K, $201K–$500K, $501K–$1M, and $1M–$2.5M.
The annual paid downloads answer options on the AppsFlyer demo form are 0, 1–100K, 101K–250K, 251K–600K, 601K–2M, and 2M+.
The number-of-employees answer options on the AppsFlyer demo form are 1-50, 51-250, 251-1,000, 1,001-5,000, and Over 5,000.
AppsFlyer premium features include API access, Protect360 Fraud Protection Suite, Audiences audience segmentation, and Data Locker.
facts.quote: Premium features include API access, Protect360 – Fraud Protection Suite, Audiences – Audience Segmentation, Data Locker, and more.

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's Zero and Growth plans do not include the premium features included in the Enterprise plan.
facts.quote: This is non-inclusive of premium features included in the Enterprise plan.

facts.fact: To become an AppsFlyer integrated partner, a company must be referred by an existing AppsFlyer customer via the platform and receive an invite link.
facts.quote: you must be referred by an existing AppsFlyer customer via our platform.

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's own page states it is trusted by more than 100,000 apps worldwide (vendor self-reported claim).
facts.quote:
Trusted by 100,000+
apps worldwide

facts.fact: AppsFlyer's page says prospects can book a discovery call with an AppsFlyer expert lasting 15 minutes before a personalized demo.
facts.quote: Book a 15-minute discovery call to discuss your goals and schedule your personalized demo
